summary: Proved by Aubian and Coulomb (Theorem 5.7, arXiv:2609.07481) and by Tang and Zhang (Corollary 1.2, arXiv:2609.02763). For each fixed twin-width bound k, the dichromatic number of a tournament is bounded by a function of its tournament clique number.

since_posted.title: Clique Number of Tournaments II
since_posted.claim: Theorem 5.7 proves that classes of tournaments with bounded twin-width are χ⃗-bounded.

since_posted.title: Bounded Twin-Width Tournaments are χ⃗-Bounded
since_posted.claim: Corollary 1.2 gives, for every k ≥ 0, a function f_k bounding the dichromatic number by f_k of the tournament clique number whenever twin-width is at most k.

notes: Corrected on 2026-09-10 following Samuel Coulomb's report; both cited results were checked in the full text. Tang and Zhang call the source conjecture 3.13, but its statement matches this catalog's original Conjecture 3.12. The result is χ⃗-boundedness, not a constant bound on dichromatic number or a claim of polynomial χ⃗-boundedness.
